methods.name: place
methods.body: const axis=this.axis;const size=axis=="x"?"width":"height";const kids=this.laid();const flexing=c=>c.flexes===true;let each=0;let flexN=0;for(const c of kids)if(c.visible&&flexing(c))flexN=flexN+1;if(flexN>0){let content=0;let visN=0;for(const c of kids){if(!c.visible)continue;visN=visN+1;if(!flexing(c))content=content+c.footprint()[size]}const extent=this.contentExtent(size);each=Math.max(0,(extent-content-this.spacing*Math.max(0,visN-1))/flexN)}const al=this.align;const cross=axis=="x"?"y":"x";const crossSize=axis=="x"?"height":"width";const crossOf=c=>{if(flexing(c))return{lead:0,extent:c[crossSize]};const fc=c.footprint();return{lead:axis=="x"?fc.y:fc.x,extent:fc[crossSize]}};let line=0;let lineBase=0;if(al!="none"){if(al=="baseline"&&axis!="x")this.refuseStackBaseline();for(const c of kids){if(!c.visible)continue;line=Math.max(line,crossOf(c).extent);const b=c.baseline;if(al=="baseline"&&typeof b=="number")lineBase=Math.max(lineBase,b)}if(al=="center"||al=="end")line=Math.max(line,this.viewExtent(crossSize))}let pos=0;return kids.map(c=>{const flex=c.visible&&flexing(c);const f=flex?null:c.footprint();const lead=f==null?0:axis=="x"?f.x:f.y;const box=axis=="x"?{x:pos-lead}:{y:pos-lead};if(flex)box[axis=="x"?"w":"h"]=each;if(al!="none"){const co=crossOf(c);const leadC=co.lead;let off=0;if(al=="center")off=(line-co.extent)/2;else if(al=="end")off=line-co.extent;else if(al=="baseline"&&axis=="x"){const b=c.baseline;if(typeof b=="number")off=lineBase-b;else if(c.visible)this.refuseBaseline(c)}box[cross]=off-(al=="baseline"?0:leadC)}if(c.visible)pos=pos+(flex?each:f[size])+this.spacing;return box})

methods.name: _restack
methods.body: if(classroot.paintsIn!=null)return;let top=null;let pinned=false;for(let n=v;n!=null&&n!=this.root;n=n.paintsIn!=null?n.paintsIn:n.parent){if(n.ignoreScroll)pinned=true;top=n}let chrome=null;if(!pinned&&!this.overlayUp&&top!=null){let after=false;for(const k of this.root.childViews){if(k==top){after=true;continue}if(after&&k!=classroot&&k.ignoreScroll&&k.visible&&k.pointerEvents!="none"&&k.height<this.root.height/2){chrome=k;break}}}classroot.raise(chrome)

methods.name: draw
methods.body: const Q=Math.PI/2;const dist=Math.abs(this.x-this._tx)+Math.abs(this.y-this._ty)+Math.abs(this.width-this._tw)+Math.abs(this.height-this._th);const lw=this.$provided("theme").focusRingWidth;let L=0,T=0,R=this.width,B=this.height;if(Math.abs(this.rotation)<.01){const sc=classroot.paintsIn!=null?classroot.paintsIn:this.root;const m=lw/2;L=Math.max(0,Math.min(sc.scrollX+m,this._tx)-this.x);T=Math.max(0,Math.min(sc.scrollY+m,this._ty)-this.y);R=Math.min(this.width,Math.max(sc.scrollX+sc.width-m,this._tx+this._tw)-this.x);B=Math.min(this.height,Math.max(sc.scrollY+sc.height-m,this._ty+this._th)-this.y);if(R-L<1||B-T<1)return}const w=R-L,h=B-T;const small=Math.min(w,h)<40;const cov=this.$provided("theme").focusSights==true&&!small?Math.max(.22,1-dist/16):1;const iw=this.$provided("theme").focusRingInnerWidth;const pass=(ins,lwp,color)=>{const r=Math.max(1,Math.min(this._rad-ins,Math.min(w,h)/2-ins));const ax=Math.max(0,((w-2*ins)/2-r)*cov);const ay=Math.max(0,((h-2*ins)/2-r)*cov);d.strokeStyle=color;d.lineWidth=lwp;d.beginPath();const x0=L+ins,y0=T+ins,x1=R-ins,y1=B-ins;d.moveTo(x0+r+ax,y0);d.lineTo(x0+r,y0);d.arc(x0+r,y0+r,r,-Q,Math.PI,true);d.lineTo(x0,y0+r+ay);d.moveTo(x1-r-ax,y0);d.lineTo(x1-r,y0);d.arc(x1-r,y0+r,r,-Q,0);d.lineTo(x1,y0+r+ay);d.moveTo(x1,y1-r-ay);d.lineTo(x1,y1-r);d.arc(x1-r,y1-r,r,0,Q);d.lineTo(x1-r-ax,y1);d.moveTo(x0+r+ax,y1);d.lineTo(x0+r,y1);d.arc(x0+r,y1-r,r,Q,Math.PI);d.lineTo(x0,y1-r-ay);d.stroke()};pass(0,lw,this.$provided("theme").focusRingColor??this.$provided("theme").accent);if(iw>0)pass((lw+iw)/2,iw,this.$provided("theme").focusRingInnerColor??this.$provided("theme").surface)

methods.name: onGeometry
methods.body: if(g.root!=this.root)return;const prev=this._lastTarget;const prevHome=this._lastHome;const hadHome=this._hasHome===true;const px=classroot.x;const py=classroot.y;classroot.paintsIn=g.scroller==this.root?null:g.scroller;const homed=g.scroller!=this.root;const gx=g.homeX;const gy=g.homeY;if(hadHome&&prevHome!=g.scroller){const toRoot=prevHome==null||prevHome==this.root?{x:px,y:py}:(()=>{const o=prevHome.rootOrigin();return{x:o.x+px-prevHome.scrollX,y:o.y+py-prevHome.scrollY}})();const dst=!homed||g.scroller==this.root?toRoot:(()=>{const o=g.scroller.rootOrigin();return{x:toRoot.x-o.x+g.scroller.scrollX,y:toRoot.y-o.y+g.scroller.scrollY}})();classroot.x=dst.x;classroot.y=dst.y}const gap=this.$provided("theme").focusRingGap;const lw=this.$provided("theme").focusRingWidth;const iw=this.$provided("theme").focusRingInnerWidth;const outside=gap+iw+lw/2;const sc=homed&&g.scroller!=this.root?g.scroller:null;const gw=g.homeW;const gh=g.homeH;const turned=g.homeRot!=0;const cutY=!turned&&sc!=null&&sc.scrolls!="y"&&(gy-outside<0||gy+gh+outside>sc.height);const cutX=!turned&&sc!=null&&sc.scrolls!="x"&&(gx-outside<0||gx+gw+outside>sc.width);const off=cutX||cutY?-(lw/2+1):outside;const ca=Math.cos(g.homeRot*Math.PI/180),sa=Math.sin(g.homeRot*Math.PI/180);const nx=gx-off*ca+off*sa,ny=gy-off*sa-off*ca;const moved=Math.abs(nx-classroot._tx)+Math.abs(ny-classroot._ty)+Math.abs(gw+2*off-classroot._tw)+Math.abs(gh+2*off-classroot._th)>.5;classroot._tx=nx;classroot._ty=ny;classroot._tw=gw+2*off;classroot._th=gh+2*off;classroot._trad=g.homeRad+off;classroot._trot=g.homeRot;this._lastTarget=g.view;this._lastHome=g.scroller;this._hasHome=true;if(classroot.shown)classroot._restack(g.view);if(prev==g.view&&moved)classroot.snapTo()
